title: Ronin
summary: Garou cast out of, or walking away from, their tribes.

claims.text: A Ronin is a werewolf outside Garou society, whether thrown out for failing a pack, defying elders or breaking the Litany, or leaving by choice because the old ways no longer fit.
The rule for the cast-out is simple: no aid and no company. Only other outcasts and the odd caern Warder will speak with one, and more Ronin roam now than ever before.
Garou name a disgraced Ronin by adding -lurf to the old name, marking one who has lost honor and the right to that name.
Self-exiles who announce their leaving keep a little honor, though they still trade favor for favor; some tribes call those who leave in Harano a Steppenwolf, a lone wolf of the steppes.
Some Ronin, called Hyenas, take bounty work from septs, bringing back strays dead or alive along with every fetish the target carried; any Ronin who falls to the Wyrm is hunted down by the tribe.
Ronin who drift too far from their own nature are said to find the Umbra harder to enter, and some to forget how to change at all.

title: The Waydown
summary: A San Francisco meeting place for Hollow Ones, in an old church.

claims.text: The Waydown, in a disused San Francisco church, is where young Hollow Ones are sent to learn about the group; its regulars say every Hollow One turns up there sooner or later, and they test newcomers before answering questions.
Its regulars insist the Hollow Ones are no Tradition, since there is nothing formal to join, and they fear spies from Marauders and Nephandi.
